subject: maths
question: A, B and C complete a work in 5 days, 6 days and 8 days, respectively. If they work together and get ₹2,950 for the work, how much amount does B get?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__ **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/deeba545e25af25513d930e1abbbe334d7a3d183d6e9a71b898b22767dcd1211.png] 

Wages is divided in the ratio of efficiency.

Total wage = 24 + 20 + 15 = 2950

⇒ 59 = 2950

Amount of B = 2950 x 20/59 = 1000

**∴ Amount of B is Rs. 1,000.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__****Given:**

A can alone complete the work = 5 days

B can alone complete the work = 6 days

C can alone complete the work = 8 days

**Concept used:**

Total work = (Sum of Efficiency) x total days

A person alone can complete the job = Total work / Efficiency of alone person

**Calculation:**

Total work = LCM of 5 days, 6 days and 8 days

⇒ 120 unit

Efficiency of A = 120/5 = 24

Efficiency of B = 120/6 = 20

Efficiency of C = 120/8 = 15

Now,

Wages is divided in the ratio of efficiency.

⇒ Total wage = 24 + 20 + 15 = 2950

⇒ 59 = 2950

Amount of B = 2950 x 20/59 = 1000

∴ Amount of B is Rs. 1,000.
